theory.overview: Computational Geometry deals with algorithms for geometric problems: point location, convex hull, line intersection, closest pair of points, polygon operations, and spatial queries. Used in computer graphics, CAD, GIS, robotics, and pattern recognition. This chapter covers fundamental geometric algorithms and their applications.

sections.title: Convex Hull
sections.content: Smallest convex polygon containing all points. Graham scan: sort by angle, scan maintaining hull. Monotone chain: sort by x, build upper and lower hull. Time: $O(n \log n)$ for sorting, $O(n)$ for scan. Space: $O(n)$. Used in collision detection, shape analysis.
algorithms: Graham scan: sort by polar angle, scan
Monotone chain: sort by x, build upper/lower hull

sections.title: Line Intersection
sections.content: Check if two line segments intersect. Compute orientation (clockwise/counterclockwise) of point triples. Segments intersect if orientations differ and bounding boxes overlap. Time: $O(1)$ per pair. Used in collision detection and graphics.
sections.algorithm: Compute orientation of (p1, p2, p3). Segments (p1,p2) and (p3,p4) intersect if orientations differ and bounding boxes overlap.

sections.title: Closest Pair of Points
sections.content: Find pair of points with minimum distance. Divide and conquer: sort by x, divide, recurse on halves, combine by checking strip of width 2d around midline. Time: $O(n \log n)$. Space: $O(n)$. Used in clustering and pattern matching.
sections.algorithm: Sort by x. Divide at midline. Recurse on halves. Check strip of width 2d around midline. Sort strip by y, check adjacent points.

sections.title: Point in Polygon
sections.content: Check if point is inside polygon. Ray casting: cast ray from point, count intersections with polygon edges. Odd count = inside, even = outside. Time: $O(n)$ where n is polygon vertices. Winding number alternative.
sections.algorithm: Cast horizontal ray to right. Count intersections with edges. Odd = inside.

sections.title: Polygon Area
sections.content: Calculate area of polygon (can be non-convex). Shoelace formula: sum over edges (x_i * y_{i+1} - x_{i+1} * y_i), take absolute, divide by 2. Time: $O(n)$. Used in GIS and graphics.

keyConcepts.name: Orientation
keyConcepts.description: Determines if three points are clockwise, counterclockwise, or collinear. Cross product of vectors.

keyConcepts.name: Convex Hull
keyConcepts.description: Smallest convex polygon containing all points. Graham scan or monotone chain algorithm.

keyConcepts.name: Divide and Conquer
keyConcepts.description: Split problem, solve recursively, combine results. Used for closest pair.

keyConcepts.name: Ray Casting
keyConcepts.description: Point in polygon test. Cast ray, count intersections. Odd = inside.

steps.title: Sort Points
steps.description: Sort points by x-coordinate (or angle for Graham scan).

steps.title: Build Lower Hull
steps.description: For monotone chain: build lower hull by adding points and removing non-left turns.
steps.code: for p in points: while len(lower) >= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], p) <= 0: lower.pop(); lower.append(p);

steps.title: Build Upper Hull
steps.code: for p in reversed(points): while len(upper) >= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], p) <= 0: upper.pop(); upper.append(p);

steps.title: Combine Hulls
steps.description: Combine lower and upper hulls (remove duplicate endpoints).

steps.title: Return Result
steps.description: Return convex hull points in order.

practiceProblems.title: Convex Hull
practiceProblems.description: Find convex hull of set of points.
practiceProblems.solution: Monotone chain algorithm. Sort by x, build upper and lower hulls.

practiceProblems.title: Max Points on a Line
practiceProblems.description: Find maximum points on same line.
practiceProblems.solution: For each point, calculate slope to all other points. Use hash map to count same slopes.

practiceProblems.title: Rectangle Overlap
practiceProblems.description: Check if two rectangles overlap.
practiceProblems.solution: Check if one rectangle is to left/right/above/below the other.
practiceProblems.hints: Check position relative to each other

practiceProblems.title: Rectangle Area
practiceProblems.description: Total area covered by rectangles (may overlap).
practiceProblems.solution: Sweep line or divide plane into regions. Count area of each region.

practiceProblems.title: Triangle
practiceProblems.description: Minimum path sum from top to bottom of triangle.
practiceProblems.solution: DP from bottom up. dp[j] = triangle[i][j] + min(dp[j], dp[j+1]).

practiceProblems.title: Valid Triangle Number
practiceProblems.description: Count triangles that can be formed from array (triangle inequality).
practiceProblems.solution: Sort array. For each pair (i,j), find k where nums[i] + nums[j] > nums[k].

practiceProblems.title: Largest Triangle Area
practiceProblems.description: Find largest triangle area from points.
practiceProblems.solution: Try all triplets, calculate area using shoelace formula.

practiceProblems.title: Triangle Validity
practiceProblems.description: Check if three sides can form triangle.
practiceProblems.solution: Triangle inequality: a + b > c, a + c > b, b + c > a.

practiceProblems.title: Angle Between Hands
practiceProblems.description: Calculate angle between hour and minute hands.
practiceProblems.solution: Hour angle = 30*h + 0.5*m. Minute angle = 6*m. Difference = |hour - minute|.

practiceProblems.title: Point in Rectangle
practiceProblems.description: Check if point is inside axis-aligned rectangle.
practiceProblems.solution: Check if point.x between left and right, point.y between bottom and top.

practiceProblems.title: Point in Circle
practiceProblems.description: Check if point is inside circle.
practiceProblems.solution: Distance from center ≤ radius.

practiceProblems.title: Overlap Circle
practiceProblems.description: Check if two circles overlap.
practiceProblems.solution: Distance between centers ≤ r1 + r2 and ≥ |r1 - r2|.

practiceProblems.title: Circle and Rectangle Overlap
practiceProblems.description: Check if circle overlaps axis-aligned rectangle.
practiceProblems.solution: Find closest point on rectangle to circle center. Check distance ≤ radius.

practiceProblems.title: Line Reflection
practiceProblems.description: Check if points are symmetric about a line.
practiceProblems.solution: For each point, find its reflection. Check if reflection exists in set.

practiceProblems.title: Minimum Area Rectangle
practiceProblems.description: Find minimum area rectangle from points (sides parallel to axes).
practiceProblems.solution: Group points by x-coordinate. For each pair of x's, find matching y pairs.
practiceProblems.hints: Group by x, find matching y pairs

practiceProblems.title: Minimum Area Rectangle II
practiceProblems.description: Find minimum area rectangle (any orientation).
practiceProblems.solution: For each pair of points as diagonal, check if other two points exist.

practiceProblems.title: Rectangle Overlap II
practiceProblems.description: Check if any rectangle overlaps with any other.
practiceProblems.solution: Sweep line. Sort by x, process events, check for overlaps.

practiceProblems.title: Perfect Rectangle
practiceProblems.description: Check if rectangles form exact cover of rectangular region.
practiceProblems.solution: Check total area matches. All corners except four outer corners should appear even times.

practiceProblems.title: Number of Boomerangs
practiceProblems.description: Count boomerangs (i, j, k where dist(i,j) = dist(i,k) and i ≠ j ≠ k).
practiceProblems.solution: For each point i, calculate distances to all other points. Count same distances.
practiceProblems.hints: Count same distances from each point

practiceProblems.title: Erect the Fence
practiceProblems.description: Find convex hull of points (return in order).
practiceProblems.solution: Monotone chain algorithm. Handle collinear points.

practiceProblems.title: Tangent Line to Circle
practiceProblems.description: Find tangent lines from point to circle.
practiceProblems.solution: Calculate using geometry. Distance from point to center, angle calculations.

practiceProblems.title: Circle and Line Intersection
practiceProblems.description: Find intersection points of line and circle.
practiceProblems.solution: Substitute line equation into circle equation, solve quadratic.

practiceProblems.title: Two Circles Intersection
practiceProblems.description: Find intersection points of two circles.
practiceProblems.solution: Calculate distance between centers. Use geometry to find intersection points.

practiceProblems.title: Polygon Perimeter
practiceProblems.description: Calculate perimeter of polygon.
practiceProblems.solution: Sum distances between consecutive vertices (including last to first).

practiceProblems.title: Polygon Centroid
practiceProblems.description: Calculate centroid of polygon.
practiceProblems.solution: Use formula: Cx = (1/6A) * Σ((xi + xi+1) * (xi * yi+1 - xi+1 * yi)).
